Tomo

Who they are

Tomo (by Mapo Labs) is a personal AI accountability coach you text — tell it a goal and it remembers the context, checks in with you proactively (it messages you first), and keeps you moving. iMessage-first / iOS, with a companion app. Positioned around 'locking in' for exams and making your dreams happen. 'Text your Tomo.' Trusted by 100,000s.

What they want

  • (No formal UGC brief provided yet — angle inferred from the product; swap in the real brief anytime.)
  • Angle to model: personal-AI / accountability / 'locking in' content that bridges into Tomo — 'the AI that keeps me on track', self-improvement + discipline, exam/study lock-in, goal + habit transformations, 'my AI texts me first'.
  • Why it converts: Tomo turns a goal into an AI that actually checks in on you — lead with a relatable 'I never follow through' moment, then show Tomo keeping you accountable.
